title: Find the Power of K-Size Subarrays II
summary: Given an array of integers and a positive integer k, determine the power of each subarray of size k.
statement: Given an array of integers and a positive integer k, determine the power of each subarray of size k. The power is the maximum element if the subarray is sorted in ascending order, otherwise, it is -1. Return an array of these powers for all subarrays of size k.
constraints: For every length-k subarray, return its last/maximum value only when values rise consecutively by one.
Return -1 for every other window, preserving window order.
hints: A window is valid exactly when the ascending-by-one run ending there has length at least k.
Track the current consecutive run length in one pass.
Reset on any broken edge; from index k-1 onward emit value or -1 based on run length.
Every output window shares its right endpoint with one tracked run, so no separate window scan is needed.
editorial: Every output window shares its right endpoint with one tracked run, so no separate window scan is needed.

Equal neighboring values are not consecutive ascending, so both windows return -1.
